title: Create: Automatics
description: This addon adds autopilot with Sable constructions, Create Aeronautics, and Create
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/398df0f9b31624c819c709072fde17abaca86e0e_0.webp)

> **Create: Automatics** is an addon that adds the ability to create an autopilot using a special item. You create routes and then insert the plan into the controller on the structure, and the car drives itself. You can create stops and customize them, and much more. The mod is currently four days old, and we're creating it with our small team.
> 

# About
This addon adds the ability to create autopilots using the Create and Sable addon. Create a route, set the speed, and launch it. The mod also adds a decorative block—a traffic cone. You can place this cone on your head and on other entities using a dispenser. The addon works very well in multiplayer; download and enjoy.
